identity_interpretation: Retrospective IDs identify distinct full persisted response records including usage and elapsed, not upstream service responses. Identical legacy records are conservatively deduplicated. Future local attempt IDs persist before invocation, survive copying and caching, and block silent retry after ambiguous interruption.

summary.interpretation: Known local records, not an invoice. Cache is within input; reasoning is within output. Unresolved attempts and missing usage are not zero. Identical legacy executions may be indistinguishable from copies.
